import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Aggregate data to get count of dogs per district
dogs_per_district = df.groupby('KreisLang').size().reset_index(name='Count')

# Plot the data
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(data=dogs_per_district, x='Count', y='KreisLang', palette='viridis')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Number of Registered Dogs per District in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('District', fontsize=12)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Aggregate data to get count of dogs per district
dogs_per_district = df.groupby('KreisLang').size().reset_index(name='Count')

# Plot the data
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(data=dogs_per_district, x='Count', y='KreisLang', palette='viridis')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Number of Registered Dogs per District in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('District', fontsize=12)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
